name: Ty's Burger House
notes: All 4 photos are the same printed menu, photographed twice at different times (prices differ slightly between the older single-page shots 1-2 and the newer two-page tabletop shots 3-4, and some digits are faded/covered by a price sticker). Merged into one dish list using photos 1-2 (clearest single-page shots) as the base, plus Eddie's Breakfast Burger which only appears in photo 3; a few illegible price digits were omitted rather than guessed. Skipped the Build Your Own Burger and Add Ons sections (customization, not fixed dishes) and the soft-drink flavor list.
